description: This file defines adapter classes for WebSocket streams to interface with TCP/TLS, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 (QUIC) streams, including delegate interfaces and methods for reading, writing, and connection management.

classes.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use a TCP/IP or TLS socket.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use an HTTP/2 stream, forwarding headers and data operations.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use an HTTP/3 (QUIC) stream, handling headers and stream lifecycle.

methods.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
methods.description: Constructor and destructor, read/write/disconnect methods, and initialization check.

methods.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, delegate detachment, read/write methods, disconnect, initialization check, and delegate event handlers.

methods.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, delegate management, header writing, read/write methods, disconnect, and event handlers for stream lifecycle.
